patch_description: Replaces the dense complete-graph K8 entangling layer with a sparse 1D ring (cycle) of CZ gates. Since the fixed data-encoding feature map already provides dense all-to-all phase entanglement (via 28 IsingZZ couplings per upload), the ansatz block only needs minimal topological connectivity to propagate these phases into observable amplitude differences. The sparse ring topology drastically reduces the gate count and circuit depth, improving parameter efficiency and reducing optimization difficulty (mitigating the barren plateau effect) while maintaining full permutation-symmetric expressive power through shared collective single-qubit rotations.
